displayIdentity.body: The letter commands remembrance of Jesus raised from the dead and descended from David, joins that gospel to imprisonment, endurance for the chosen, a faithful saying, and God’s faithfulness.
displayIdentity.title: Remember Jesus Christ, risen and descended from David
